title: How would you set up an AI day-trading workflow, and any good free real-time data?
author: Exciting-Topic3902
selftext: Does anyone know how to set up a workflow for day traders? I want to use my Grok Bot AI to day trade, but I'm not sure how to set up the system. Should I make an initial system bot on my PC or in the cloud, like a filter and stuff, and then let that connect into the Grok Bot to make the final decision? Or do you guys know any good free data to access the market, so the data can be fed second by second, very quickly?

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
keep grok out of the second-by-second loop. a model call takes a few seconds, so by then the move is gone. a plain script on your pc or a cheap vps does the filter and the stops, and the AI only sees the shortlist and says yes or no. alpaca's free plan streams IEX quotes over a websocket for data.

that paper half is why Quantradin exists. I built it as somewhere an agent can trade fake money on real prices before anyone trusts it. quantradin.com

what timeframe are you planning on?
